name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション ギロロロボMk-II
name.en: Keroro Sergeant Plastic Model Collection Giroro Robo Mk-II

ja: 大砲やミサイルなど全身武器だらけ“ギロロロボMk-II”登場。
ロボ形態からタンク形態へ変形。
ロボに乗り込むギロロ伍長も手足が可動。
ギロロ伍長はロボのコクピットにもなるソーサーに乗せることが可能。
en: Introducing the “Giroro Robo Mk-II”, which is full of weapons such as cannons and missiles.
Transforms from robot form to tank form.
Corporal Giroro who rides the robot also has movable limbs.
Corporal Giroro can be placed on a saucer that also serves as the robot's cockpit.
